title: Format US phone numbers
prompt:
Please add `format_us_phone(raw)` to contacts.py. It takes a phone number string as typed by a user and returns it formatted as `(415) 555-0123`.

Rules:
- Spaces, parentheses, hyphens, dots and `+` are ignored. Any other non-digit character (letters, slashes, and so on) raises ValueError.
- After removing those, there must be exactly 10 digits, or 11 digits where the first is `1` (the country code, which is dropped). Anything else raises ValueError, including an empty string.
- The area code (first three of the 10 digits) and the exchange (next three) may not start with 0 or 1; raise ValueError if either does.

Examples: `"415-555-0123"`, `"(415) 555.0123"`, `"+1 415 555 0123"` and `"14155550123"` all give `"(415) 555-0123"`.
acceptance: 10-digit and 11-digit-with-leading-1 inputs with assorted separators format correctly; wrong lengths, an 11-digit number not starting with 1, letters or other characters, and area code/exchange starting with 0 or 1 raise ValueError.
difficulty_rationale: One function with a short, fully stated rule set.
